title: Falling for U
lyrics:
[00:20.00]I was hangin' with you and then I realized
[00:22.97]I didn't think it was true, I was surprised
[00:26.55]When I found out, I'd fallen for you
[00:31.93]I didn't wanna believe my feelin's for you
[00:34.83]I didn't wanna believe that I could lose you
[00:38.44]If I told you just how I felt
[00:43.21]But I can't help it
[00:46.09]I'm falling for U
[00:48.86]And I can't quit it
[00:51.85]'Cause I'm stuck on you
[00:54.91]And it might be pathetic and you might be skeptical
[00:58.52]But I just want to be with you
[01:01.52]Please tell me, boy, can you get a clue or come through
[01:04.34]'Cause I just want to be with you
[01:07.00]I'm scared
[01:10.18]Of tellin' you how I feel
[01:13.09]Maybe it's better
[01:15.89]If I just try to conceal
[01:18.83]The truth for me
[01:21.91]And for you
[01:23.56]But I'm still stuck on you
[01:31.35]Aye
[01:35.91]I'm still falling for U
[01:39.81]For U
